description: This Java source file defines a command handler class 'LoanApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler' that processes loan withdrawal commands initiated by an applicant. It utilizes annotations for service designation and transaction management, and implements an interface to handle command processing by invoking the corresponding service method.

classes.name: LoanApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service component implementing command handling for loan withdrawal initiated by an applicant, triggered by the 'WITHDRAW' action on 'LOAN' entities.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the withdrawal command by invoking the loan application write platform service to process the applicant withdrawal from the loan application.
